senses.gloss: forewarning, prohibition, esp. the explicit prohibition (‘thou shalt not’) in the Bible, required for punishing trespassers.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:41">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> top <he>א׳ ללה״ר</he> a biblical admonition against calumny.
Num. R. s. 7 (play on zara Num. XI, 20) והי׳ לכם לא׳ it shall be a warning to you.
<cite ref="Yevamot 3b:15">Yeb. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ שמענו וכ׳</he> we learn here the legal prohibition, whence do we derive the penalty? a. tr.—Pl. <he>אַזְהָרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3:1">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00445"><he>אִדַּר</he></cite>.
